app_fee.value: Central research guidance lists tuition fee lookup and scholarship funding with no general application fee stated for postgraduate research degrees.

fee_waiver.value: Central research guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Sheffield.

toefl_min.value: English language requirements vary depending on what you study; requirements for research degrees are published on specific PhD course webpages.
toefl_min.quote: The IELTS requirements for research degrees are published on our PhD webpages.

ielts_min.value: English language requirements vary depending on what you study; requirements for research degrees are published on specific PhD course webpages.
ielts_min.quote: The IELTS requirements for research degrees are published on our PhD webpages.

english_waiver.value: Waivers apply to degrees taught in English in person in a majority native English speaking country; degrees from non-majority native English speaking countries require approved tests.
english_waiver.quote: If you have recently been awarded a first degree or postgraduate diploma taught in English in person in a majority native English speaking country, you will not normally need to provide other evidence of English language ability. You should have been awarded your degree/diploma within five years of the start date of your Sheffield course.

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at the University of Sheffield include PhD, MPhil, and PhD with Integrated Masters programmes across faculties.
